frozen: 2026-10-19, written before any wrist fit was run

per_camera_PASS_requires_all.data: at least 40 informative train frames and 20 informative val frames (real robot mask outside the static ignore region >= 0.5% of the image)
per_camera_PASS_requires_all.mask_quality: segmentation previews of val frames show the other arm/gripper masked without large background or can inclusions (visual check, documented)
per_camera_PASS_requires_all.heldout: on camera_cal_val, median per-frame symmetric chamfer distance (px) of fitted mount <= 0.75 x that of the current cfg mount AND median IoU of fitted mount > cfg
per_camera_PASS_requires_all.stability: all multi-start solutions whose train cost is within 5% of the best agree within 1.5 cm and 2 deg
per_camera_PASS_requires_all.uncertainty: episode-bootstrap (8 resamples of train episodes) std <= 1.0 cm per axis and <= 1.5 deg
per_camera_PASS_requires_all.identifiability: each of the 6 parameters raises the train cost by >= 1% for a 1 cm / 1 deg perturbation from the optimum

BLOCK_if: any criterion fails for a camera -> stop and hand over a ChArUco capture protocol; no manual GUI fallback
caveat: Silhouettes are compared at matched JOINT states only; this validates camera-vs-robot-kinematics alignment, not object pose or contact.
